description: ERR-ADO (T: a provider warning cannot be induced), variant: a recording sink on ConnectionEvents (InfoMessage) of an ADODB.Connection (Provider Microsoft.ACE.OLEDB.12.0, read-write, the fixture). Recordsets are opened with requests ACE may downgrade: CursorType 2 (dynamic) with LockType 3 (optimistic); CursorType 3 (static) with LockType 4 (batch optimistic); forward-only with LockType 2 (pessimistic); and Execute of a SELECT; the cursor and lock type read back, Connection.Errors read, and the events the sink records (InfoMessage or not) are compared.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
